description: Resolve one hostname for one record type (A, AAAA, MX, TXT, NS, CNAME, SOA, CAA) over DNS-over-HTTPS, returning every record with its TTL, the resolver that answered and the DNS response code. It tries a second resolver before giving up, and when nothing comes back it says so with the rcode instead of reporting an empty success. Use it for email deliverability checks, domain ownership evidence, or pre-flight checks before calling an API. Paid per call via x402 (USDC on Base, no account, no API key). 【価格】0.00 USDC。【使い方】呼ぶと 402 と PAYMENT-REQUIRED（支払い条件）が返る。USDC で支払い、同じ引数に PAYMENT-SIGNATURE ヘッダを添えて再送すると結果が返る。

type.description: Record type (default A): A, AAAA, MX, TXT, NS, CNAME, SOA, CAA
